Empires & Puzzles Jolt Review: The Electric Navigator

Jolt promises high-voltage action with Very Fast speed and a massive Ice attack buff. But does her low damage multiplier leave her short-circuited in today's meta? We break down why she's a mono-team specialist.
Jolt: The Very Fast Flashbang for Mono-Blue
Jolt bursts onto the scene as a member of the

family, representing the Ice faction. Released in early 2024, she was designed as a speed demon, boasting Very Fast mana and an ability set clearly intended to supercharge blue stacks. While she doesn't have a costume (yet), her base form offers a mix of utility and team buffs that can be electrifying in the right setup—or a bit of a damp squib if used incorrectly. She's essentially a magical battery pack: great for jump-starting your other appliances, but you wouldn't use her to hammer a nail.

Jolt's design screams "electric personality." She features a vibrant, anime-inspired aesthetic with shocking blue hair and electric arcs crackling around her. It's a high-energy look that fits her "Chain Lightning" theme perfectly. The color palette is, predictably, very blue, but the dynamic pose suggests movement and speed, aligning perfectly with her Very Fast mana generation. She looks like she's about to start a rave or end a battle, possibly both.

If you pulled Jolt early, congratulations! She will carry your Blue stack for a long time. Focus on keeping her alive and pair her with your other blue heroes, even 3-stars like Nordri, to maximize her buff. Do not put her on Defense.

where you need multiple deep blue teams, she is fantastic. She is

The community reaction to Jolt was... mixed.

However, the damage was a major sticking point. A common sentiment was:
"That low damage needs to be increased... It pales in comparison to mono."
Another veteran pointed out the harsh reality of her design:
"Jolt is strictly a mono blue hero... if it wasn't the blind at v fast she is quite average."
There was also confusion about her mechanics, with players asking:
"How much damage will be really dealt with Jolt? I can’t put a number on this damage."

Jolt is the energy drink of Empires & Puzzles: a quick burst of power that gets your team going, but offers little nutritional value on her own. In an era of monsters dealing 600% damage to all, Jolt's 215% is laughable. Yet, you don't bring a battery to a sword fight to hit people with it; you bring it to power the laser. If you play Mono Blue, she is a staple. If you don't, she's fodder for the Soul Exchange.
